_readme: Towns that get one estimated AQHI (eAQHI) from their own PurpleAir sensors. build_pa_regional_aqhi.py writes data/community_eaqhi.json from this every 30 min; the LiveMap town diamonds, the LIFX bulbs (lifx_lights, source pa_community) and the dk_LIFX page all read that one file. lat/lon = where the map diamond goes. Only list sensors IN the town (Jasper's SkyTram upper terminal and Barrhead's Neerlandia sensor are left out on purpose). Added 2026-10-05.
